search.name: find_released
search.description: Search the O'Reilly catalog for released books, videos, courses and other recorded content on a topic (not live events: find_live_events has those). Every item is labelled Released and the list is newest first. For one person's work use find_by_author.
search.argumentDescription: Descriptive keywords for the topic, not a question

search.name: find_scheduled
search.description: Search the O'Reilly catalog for books, videos and courses on a topic that are announced but not yet released. Every item is labelled Scheduled and the list is soonest first.
search.argumentDescription: Descriptive keywords for the topic, not a question

search.name: find_by_author
search.description: Find the work of one author in the O'Reilly catalog, books and live events included. Books (up to 50 per status) come first as released_books newest first and scheduled_books soonest first; other recorded formats (videos, courses and more) are only the newest 25 per status; upcoming_live_events lists the author's live events and live courses with every session date, soonest first. A message says when a list may be missing items, or when the name matches more than one author entry (then authors holds one separate group per entry, each with author, item_counts, topics, formats, publishers and its own lists). Durations are text such as 10 h 31 min. Every item is labelled Released or Scheduled.

search.name: find_title
search.description: Look up one named book, video or course in the O'Reilly catalog, whether it is released or scheduled. Items are ordered by how well they match the title; each is labelled Released or Scheduled.
search.argumentDescription: The title, or the words of it you know

search.name: find_live_events
search.description: Search the O'Reilly catalog for upcoming live events and live courses on a topic, with their session dates, soonest first. Past events are never listed. For one person's live events use find_by_author.
search.argumentDescription: Descriptive keywords for the topic, not a question

expert.name: ask_experts
expert.description: Ask O'Reilly's expert-authored library a specific technical question and get back grounded, citable snippets (each with product_id, offset, the book or video title, authors, publication date, chapter, a snippet preview and a learning.oreilly.com link). It returns passages to cite, not a list of titles; every claim made from them must name the item and link it returned. Results reflect the asking account's O'Reilly access. Use find_released or find_by_author to browse the catalog instead.

question.description: The technical question, in plain words

context.description: What the asker is working on or trying to achieve

author.description: Restrict results to works by this author

published_after.description: Only results published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

published_before.description: Only results published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

within_product_id.description: Restrict the search to one item, by a returned product_id

expert.name: get_citation
expert.description: Retrieve the full, citable source text of one snippet that ask_experts returned. Only a product_id and offset from an ask_experts result in this conversation work; any other pair is refused.

product_id.description: The product_id of the snippet, from an ask_experts result

offset.description: The offset of the snippet, from the same result

noExpertAccess: This O'Reilly account does not include Expert Intelligence (the Expert MCP entitlement), so the Expert tools are refused. Nothing was retrieved; say so and do not answer from memory.
